Convert to gallons: 1 gallon = 3.78541 liters. So gallons per mile = 0.132 / 3.78541 = 0.0349 gal/mile. For 980 miles, gallons needed = 980 * 0.0349 ≈ 34.2 gallons. But we currently have 42% of 50 gallons = 21 gallons. So we need to add 34.2 - 21 = 13.2 gallons. Minimum integer gallons to add: ceil(13.2) = 14 gallons. But we might want to ensure we don't exceed tank capacity: 14 + 21 = 35 < 50, fine.\n\nBut we also need to consider that the fuel range reported is 560 km (~348 mi). So fuel range 560 km corresponds to 12.15 gallons. That matches the fuel level 42% of 50 gallons = 21 gallons? Wait 42% of 50 = 21 gallons. But fuel range says 560 km remaining. That would correspond to 12.15 gallons. There's inconsistency. But we trust the fuel range metric: 560 km remaining. That means we have enough fuel for 560 km. But we need 1580 km. So we need extra 1020 km. At 8.2 L/100 km, that's 83.64 L = 22.1 gallons. So we need to add at least 22.1 gallons. But we can't exceed tank capacity: 50 gallons total. We currently have 21 gallons? Actually fuel level 42% of 50 gallons = 21 gallons. So adding 22.1 gallons would exceed capacity. So we cannot reach Rivermist with a single fill. But maybe the fuel level 42% refers to percent of tank, but fuel range 560 km indicates less than 42%? Something wrong. Let's compute fuel level from fuel range: 560 km remaining at 8.2 L/100 km uses 45.92 L = 12.15 gallons. That would be 24% of 50 gallons. So fuel level should be 24%. But reported fuel level is 42%. So either fuel range is inaccurate or fuel level is inaccurate. We'll use fuel level 42% = 21 gallons. Then fuel range 560 km is inconsistent. But we can still compute needed gallons: 34.2 gallons needed total. We have 21 gallons. Need 13.2 gallons. Round up to 14 gallons. So we can call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 14.")

But we currently have 42% of 50 gallons = 21 gallons. So we need to add 34.2 - 21 = 13.2 gallons. Minimum integer gallons to add: ceil(13.2) = 14 gallons. That would correspond to 12.15 gallons. There's inconsistency. But we trust the fuel range metric: 560 km remaining. That means we have enough fuel for 560 km. But we need 1580 km. So we need extra 1020 km. At 8.2 L/100 km, that's 83.64 L = 22.1 gallons. So we need to add at least 22.1 gallons. But we can't exceed tank capacity: 50 gallons total. We currently have 21 gallons? Actually fuel level 42% of 50 gallons = 21 gallons. So adding 22.1 gallons would exceed capacity. So we cannot reach Rivermist with a single fill. But maybe the fuel level 42% refers to percent of tank, but fuel range 560 km indicates less than 42%? Something wrong. Let's compute fuel level from fuel range: 560 km remaining at 8.2 L/100 km uses 45.92 L = 12.15 gallons. That would be 24% of 50 gallons. So fuel level should be 24%. But reported fuel level is 42%. So either fuel range is inaccurate or fuel level is inaccurate. We'll use fuel level 42% = 21 gallons. Then fuel range 560 km is inconsistent. But we can still compute needed gallons: 34.2 gallons needed total. We have 21 gallons. Need 13.2 gallons. Round up to 14 gallons. So we can call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 14.")

Convert to gallons: 1 gallon = 3.78541 liters. So gallons per mile = 0.132 / 3.78541 = 0.0349 gal/mile. For 980 miles, gallons needed = 980 * 0.0349 ≈ 34.2 gallons. But we currently have 42% of 50 gallons = 21 gallons. So we need to add 34.2 - 21 = 13.2 gallons. Minimum integer gallons to add: ceil(13.2) = 14 gallons. But we might want to ensure we don't exceed tank capacity: 14 + 21 = 35 < 50, fine.\n\nBut we also need to consider that the fuel range reported is 560 km (~348 mi). So fuel range 560 km corresponds to 12.15 gallons. That matches the fuel level 42% of 50 gallons = 21 gallons? Wait 42% of 50 = 21 gallons. But fuel range says 560 km remaining. That would correspond to 12.15 gallons. There's inconsistency. But we trust the fuel range metric: 560 km remaining. That means we have enough fuel for 560 km. But we need 1580 km. So we need extra 1020 km. At 8.2 L/100 km, that's 83.64 L = 22.1 gallons. So we need to add at least 22.1 gallons. But we can't exceed tank capacity: 50 gallons total. We currently have 21 gallons? Actually fuel level 42% of 50 gallons = 21 gallons. So adding 22.1 gallons would exceed capacity. So we cannot reach Rivermist with a single fill. But maybe the fuel level 42% refers to percent of tank, but fuel range 560 km indicates less than 42%? Something wrong. Let's compute fuel level from fuel range: 560 km remaining at 8.2 L/100 km uses 45.92 L = 12.15 gallons. That would be 24% of 50 gallons. So fuel level should be 24%. But reported fuel level is 42%. So either fuel range is inaccurate or fuel level is inaccurate. We'll use fuel level 42% = 21 gallons. Then fuel range 560 km is inconsistent. But we can still compute needed gallons: 34.2 gallons needed total. We have 21 gallons. Need 13.2 gallons. Round up to 14 gallons. So we can call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 14.")
